key_insight: SciWorkBench evaluates AI agents on realistic scientific workflows, revealing persistent gaps in executing research projects reliably.
engineering_relevance: For materials research teams, the benchmark highlights the need to validate agents across complete workflows rather than isolated scientific tasks.
method: Build tasks from peer-reviewed literature and expert-contributed scenarios across four scientific domains.
Categorize tasks using a unified scientific analysis framework validated by domain experts.
Evaluate models in Claude Code and Codex agent frameworks with unified execution and grading.
evidence_signal: Across biology, chemistry, materials science, and physics tasks, the best-performing agent achieved a mean score of 57.38.
watch_item: Agents struggle with task-specific procedures, multimodal evidence integration, and scientific self-correction; the abstract does not report materials-specific performance.
paper_title: SciWorkBench: A Benchmark for Real Scientific Workflows
